newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-UHISPANK SAYS PLEASED WITH IBCA RATING.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-UHISPANK SAYS PLEASED WITH IBCA RATING.

text.p: Uhispank said on Tuesday that it was pleased with the short-term debt rating of 2 from international rating agency IBCA.
Uhispank earlier said it was given the rating on Friday.

"Uhispank considers the rating of 2 a good result because on a five point system, a 1 rating is given only to banks that have secure legal guarantees or a state guarantee," Uhispank, Estonia's second-largest bank, said in a statement.
The bank said that it intends to commission a long-term rating in association with the central bank's plans to take sovereign country rating.
